title: Remove Duplicates (Preserve Order)
description:
Return a new list with duplicates removed, preserving the original order of first occurrence. Do not use `set()` directly (you may use a set to track seen items).

**Example:**
```
remove_duplicates([1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 4]) → [1, 2, 3, 4]
remove_duplicates([5, 5, 5]) → [5]
remove_duplicates([]) → []
```
hint: Maintain a 'seen' set and a result list. For each item, add to result only if not yet seen.
